planner: mission-control iteration 255 sprint-planner (killed mid-run, rc=143); reviewed, re-measured and finished by iteration 256 sprint-planner

notes: The pinned binary is the ONLY gate instrument.
The Bash tool shell is zsh: run gate scripts with bash; zsh does not word-split $X.
Use /usr/bin/grep in scripts (the rig grep is ugrep).
go build is not a compile fence for _test.go files: use go test -run '^$' ./... and go vet ./...
The executor must NOT run scripts/verify_go.sh; the controller runs it after run B.
The executor runs no git write (no add/commit/stash/checkout/restore/branch). Mutant restores use cp + cmp, never git checkout.
Known base flakes: TestExecSrtMCP* (CI), TestCommitInvocationReceiptIdentity under -race; re-run once alone, report by name.

ratification.D2b: Byte form and packetHash rule are an IRREVERSIBLE freeze once a packet is stored (design D2b). With D4 held no production path stores a packet (plan PD29), so the freeze is landed and test-pinned but not yet exercised in production.
ratification.D4: HELD. The controller files D-WORLD-73 with the design's default: land M1 and M3's validator and hold M2's daemon binding. Step C4.2 (binding + serialization: AC3 daemon arm, AC8, MD2, MD3) is not implemented this sprint; host/daemon/daemon.go is frozen.

ratified_deferrals_do_not_fix: Do NOT implement C4.2 (d.binder Human.Approve binding, humanMu, human field, serializedHandler). D-WORLD-73 is held.
Do NOT change the frozen refusal sentences, including code 5's 'newest 40 approval heads' wording (PD28 is reported, not fixed).
Do NOT absorb Future Work #1 (approvals-head CAS), #2 (general REST semantic-ID passthrough), #3 (request-identity collapse), #5 (TR.C blindness to Registry insertions).
Do NOT edit invoke_boundary_test.go (TR.C wantCount stays 3) or any existing _test.go except host/verifygate/module_manifest_gate_test.go's five PD3 sites.
